question: Can a bounded public-history coherence gate prevent the known WSP163 rapid hidden-switching regression while retaining most of its within-episode persistent hidden-regime learning, and how does it compare with independently trained Bayesian persistence-vs-iid controls given identical source-free public episodes?
hypothesis: A single frozen WSP163 4D autoregressive direct-weight model with a public-evidence reliability gate (5 prior public records; last four consecutive residual cosine similarities above a FIT-calibrated cap between 0.75 and 0.86) will reduce persistent later-step VALID RMSE by >=0.04 versus same-data fully fitted static WSP160, and incur iid hidden-step RMSE regret <=0.01 versus that static model in all three new seeded source-free replicas. The fitted conventional Bayesian persistence-vs-iid mixture is independently trained on identical public FIT evidence and may tie or beat the direct gated learner; any superiority claim requires new strong-control evidence, not assumed here.
predecessor_evidence: WSP163 PR1218 finalized SHA245dae308bc3b7ca04b2a5af574ffc45cd6621a4 G29 #44266791915 and full #44266783693 dual OS PASS; historical three seeds persistent later static~0.143 vs history~0.03 but iid memory regret +0.0338..+0.0675; retain frozen scientific DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO.
WSP163 cross-OS numeric metrics match but JSON checkpoint hashes/length differ; do not claim portable byte-identical state or silently normalize prior evidence.
WSP162 PR1216 static public-only prediction irreducible overlap floor; history is extra observed evidence, no hidden labels.
CKAD PR1207 independently runs native context recovery and does not confer WSP first-use/model integration authority.

inputs.name: Existing WSP163 public history source-free readout / fixtures
inputs.source: unchanged qualified research module; reused same authored generator family but NEW seeded independent episodes

inputs.name: New source-free public episode replicas
inputs.source: WSP163 fixtures(seed) with disjoint seeds 1931/2053/2179, each 32×16 FIT persistent +16×16 VALID persistent +16×16 held iid-switch; 4D states and public outcomes only

inputs.name: Independent fully fitted conventional Bayesian control
inputs.source: Self-supervised inferred two-component residual emission prototypes and empirical Beta-smoothed regime persistence from SAME FIT public residuals; Bayesian odds of persistent vs iid hypothesis updated from preceding public inferred state changes only; no hidden family labels and no held target read before forecast

frozen_design.split: Same unmodified authored 16-public-state-context fixture family as WSP163, but 3 new independent deterministic seed draws not evaluated in WSP163. Each seed 32 persistent FIT episodes x16 rows; 16 disjoint persistent VALID episodes x16; 16 held iid-switch stress episodes x16. Hidden source regime labels NEVER passed to learner or controls. Not unfamiliar source families or original-science first-use.
frozen_design.ordering: First single-file prereg commit; source/tests fixed before any new scored metrics. Train WSP160 base on all 512 FIT public rows, WSP163 lag-RLS on 480 within-episode FIT witness pairs, then calibrate one source-free gate threshold from FIT residual pair similarities. In held VALID predict before seeing current outcome, only last <=5 *previously* witnessed public records from same episode; reset history at terminal. Score persistent and IID; no post-result tuning; preserve negative.
frozen_design.data_budget: 3 seeds x (512 FIT+256 VALID persistent+256 held iid) source-free public transitions. All conventional controls see 512 FIT and same preceding public within-episode histories. Zero original CartPoleWind/Gym reset/step/do/ctf_do, zero paid calls, no new source actor.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib only; existing WSP160 4x10, WSP163 4x4 learner one shared model; gate calibration <=480 FIT public adjacent residual pairs; 5-entry fixed public evidence window. Bayesian control <=2 discrete hidden modes, fitted residual prototypes and smoothed stay probability, no oracle labels. Exactly 3 new frozen replicas and final source-identical Linux/Windows full root+NKR05/G29.
frozen_design.capacity: No new direct coefficient parameters beyond WSP163 base+lag readout. Gate has one learned scalar threshold from FIT public consecutive cosine similarities: max(0.75, min(0.86, mean_cosine -0.10)). Use threshold on EACH of the four last adjacent public residual cosine pairs; 5 prior public witness records required, then all-or-nothing current lag correction. No adjustment based on held loss, labels or hidden regime; no per-world bank.
frozen_design.evaluator: Compute held later-step (t>=1) and whole-episode RMSE for gated, un-gated WSP163, WSP160 static, conventional Bayesian persistence-vs-iid mixture, inexpensive simple public residual carry, plus shuffled-history negative. Score persistent and IID separately, same actual previously witnessed public rows, never future. Record number of gated-on forecasts, learning threshold per seed, first-step strict parity, native checkpoint compatibility and OS drift, fit/eval CPU and source actions.

controls: Existing unchanged WSP163 un-gated learned 4x4 history-RLS from same FIT public rows (known IID failure); must not retune after results.
Same-data fully fitted STATIC WSP160 baseline with no history.

Independent Bayesian 2-mode persistent-vs-IID mixture: FIT public residuals infer two emission prototypes by residual first-coordinate sign, Beta(1,1)-smoothed within-episode same-sign transition probability (clipped [0.51,0.99]); equal 0.5 prior on persistent/iid process, online posterior using public sign transition likelihoods only; predicts current mean mode, no oracle family or current target.
Same-history cheap previous-public-residual carry; no learned lag coefficient
Shuffled public FIT histories used as reliability negative; if that outperforms aligned history report failure.
Wrong history crosses episode terminal, invalid privileged fields / current future outcomes, empty-history first-step, tampered state and nonfinite cases must reject
Cross-platform weight checkpoint hash/byte size differences retained explicitly, never called exact deterministic unless independently observed.

classification_rules.supported: SOURCEFREE_RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_SUPPORTED iff every seed has persistent later static-gated RMSE >=0.04; iid gated regret <=0.01 (gated minus static); original un-gated WSP163 iid regret reproduces positive >=0.01; gate NEVER uses current outcome/future/hidden regime; same-OS cold outputs exact; final focused/full inherited root+NKR05/G29 on exact final Linux/Windows PASS. Bayesian control is separately reported and may outperform; no scientific claim.
classification_rules.mixed: If a seed improves persistent while IID gate regret >0.01 or loses >=0.04 improvement, freeze DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO under this prereg. Cross-platform state bytes differ -> TRANSPORT_DETERMINISM_UNVERIFIED even if scalar metrics match; no promotion.
classification_rules.negative: Failure to gate based on prior history, new hidden oracle leak, future leak, bad matched controls, or any prespecified threshold misses; preserve results, no post-result source/seed/threshold adjustment.
classification_rules.invalid: Any external original source execution, hidden regime supplied as feature, held VALID used in FIT threshold, after-result test/code edits presented as confirmatory, modified inherited WSP/CKAD, unsafe controller/accepted main changes.

future_gate: If even Bayesian reliability cannot preserve IID, separately freeze richer public-state/time/event evidence and exact matched strong HMM/change-point controls; avoid endless gated retuning. Original-source first use still requires independent source-owner virgin actor/cohort signoff.
